args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Halvorsen Blog Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion):

• Autonomous carts lifted warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
• Integration took twice as long as planned.
• The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
